body:
*NCAP-SELEX preparation*

**sol1 Salt solution: 2M KCl\_1.491g KCl \+ 10mL TE \+ cocktail Tablet \+ 1mM TCEP**

50 mL X 2

| KCl | 7.46 g |
| :---- | :---- |
| 100 mM TCEP | 0.5 mL |
| TE Buffer (100X) | 0.5 mL |
| EDTA-free protease inhibitor | 1 tablet |

Filter, mix well and aliquot. Add 130 uL per well of 2 X  4titude 96-well plates. Use one plate for making 6 384-well NUNC plate aliquots.

**TCAPT Block Buffer**

500 mL

| 10X TCAPT | 50 mL |
| :---- | :---- |
| BSA | 0.5 g |
| 10% NaN3 | 1 mL |

**Biotin Buffer plates**

200 mL

| 1X TCAPT Block | 100 mL |
| :---- | :---- |
| Biotin | 0.49 g |
| Imidazole | 0.68 g |
| 10 M NaOH | 120 uL |

Make up the volume to 200 mL. DO NOT filter and aliquot 25 uL per well to 12 plates (needs \~120 mL buffer).

**Nucleosome Dilution buff: TE buffer \+ 1mM TCEP \+ cocktail Tablet \+ 2mM MgCl2**

500 mL

| TE Buffer (100X) | 5 mL |
| :---- | :---- |
| 100 mM TCEP | 5 mL |
| MgCl2 (1 M) | 1 mL |
| EDTA-free protease inhibitor | 10 tablets |

100 mM TCEP ⇒ 0.29 g in 10 mL water

**TF Dilution Buffer**

500 mL

| 1 M Tris-HCl pH 8 | 5 mL |
| :---- | :---- |
| BSA | 0.5 g |
| KCl | 5.59 g |
| Ethylene Glycol | 250 mL |
| 100 mM ZnSO4.H2O | 50 uL |

**Elution Buffer**

0.1% Tween, 10 mM Tris pH7.8, 1 mM MgCl2 (0.5mM in PCR rxn)  
   
500 mL buffer:  
\-    	500 uL Tween20  
\-    	5 mL Tris pH 8  
\-    	500 uL 1M MgCl2

*PE Phusion Mix (16X)*

| PE Phusion Mix |  |  |  |
| ----- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Reagents | per well in 384 | per 384-well plate | for 16 plates |
| MQ water | 2.39642μL | 1055.25 μL | 16884 μL |
| 5x Phusion HF buffer | 2.47818μL | 1091.25 μL | 17460 μL |
| 10mM dNTP | 0.48542μL | 213.75 μL | 3420 μL |
| MgCl2 (50mM) | 0.49819μL | 219.375 μL | 3510 μL |
| HF Phusion DNA Pol (2U/µL) | 0.14179μL | 62.4375 μL | 999 μL |
| Total | 6μL | 2642.0625 μL | 42.273 mL |

Add 10 uL of 100 uM PE\_F primer per 1 mL of primer mix i.e. to the total mix we add 422.8 uL of 100 uM PE\_F primer.

PCR1 plates  
PCR (For 8 plates)

| PCR Plates |  |  |  |
| ----- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Reagents | per well in 384 | per 384-well plate | for 8 plates (x440) |
| NF water | 8.65μL | 3.323mL | 30.48mL |

| NCAP\_F 100μM  | 0.075μL | 28.8μL | 264μL |
| NCAP\_R 100μM  | 0.075μL | 28.8μL | 264μL |
| MgCl2 (50mM) | 0.0975μL | 37.44μL | 343μL |

| Total | 13.51μL | 5.189mL | 47.57mL |

*qPCR Mix*

qPCR (6 plates)

| qPCR Plates |  |  |  |
| ----- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Reagents | per well in 384 | per 384-well plate | for 6 plates (x440) |
| NF water | 2.91 μL | 1.12 mL | 7.68 mL |
| 5x Phusion HF buffer | 1.25 μL | 480 μL | 3.3 mL |
| 10mM e dNTP | 0.25 μL | 96 μL | 660 μL |
| NCAP\_F 100μM  | 0.025 μL | 9.6 μL | 66 μL |
| NCAP\_R 100μM  | 0.025 μL | 9.6 μL | 66 μL |
| MgCl2 (50mM) | 0.0325 μL | 12.48 μL | 85.8 μL |
| Hot Start Phusion DNA Pol | 0.0375 μL | 14.4 μL | 99 μL |
| 100x SYBR (final 1:200) | 0.06 μL | 23.04 μL | 158.4 μL |
| Total | 4.59 μL | 1.765 mL | 12.1155 mL |

To prepare 100x SYBR Green: add 5μL 10,000x SYBR Green into 500μL DMSO, which can be found in Phusion DNA Pol kits. Avoid light. Manually load 122μL mix into each well of a 96-well plate (AB0765), then transfer 4.5μL/well into 6x 384-well plates (LightCycler 384).

*PCR2 mix (6.5) plates*

300 uL  per well of a Greiner Round PP plate → 3 X 4ti384 well plates

Top up the same plate and then prepare another 3 plates.

![](assets/img/doc3-image15.png)

*Shortlisting TFs for next SELEX*

| \# | Four-TF combination | Regulatory context | Interaction model |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| 1 | **POU5F1 · SOX2 · NANOG · KLF4** | Pluripotency and reprogramming | Cooperative enhancer binding and chromatin opening |
| 2 | **GATA4 · NKX2-5 · TBX5 · MEF2A** | Cardiac specification | Direct interactions and extensive enhancer co-occupancy |
| 3 | **ASCL1 · POU3F2 · MYT1L · NEUROD1** | Neuronal conversion | ASCL1-led pioneering followed by cooperative neuronal activation |
| 4 | **FOXA2 · HNF4A · HNF1A · CEBPA** | Hepatic identity | FOXA2-mediated pioneering with liver-enhancer co-occupancy |
| 5 | **FOXA2 · PDX1 · NEUROD1 · MAFA** | Pancreatic β cells | Pioneer-assisted co-regulation of β-cell enhancers |
| 6 | **GATA2 · RUNX1 · FLI1 · TAL1** | HSPC/megakaryocyte programme | Strong multi-factor enhancer co-occupancy |
| 7 | **GATA1 · TAL1 · KLF1 · NFE2** | Erythroid differentiation | Cooperative erythroid enhancer and globin-locus binding |
| 8 | **SPI1 · IRF8 · CEBPA · RUNX1** | Macrophage/myeloid identity | SPI1/CEBPA chromatin priming with IRF8–RUNX1 collaboration |
| 9 | **ESR1 · FOXA1 · GATA3 · TFAP2C** | Luminal breast/estrogen response | FOXA1/GATA3-established enhancers followed by ESR1 recruitment |
| 10 | **AR · FOXA1 · HOXB13 · GATA2** | Prostate/androgen response | Pioneer-factor control of the AR cistrome |
| 11 | **TFAP2A · FOXD3 · SOX10 · PAX3** | Neural-crest specification | Pioneer-like establishment and lineage-network reinforcement |
| 12 | **MITF · SOX10 · TFAP2A · PAX3** | Melanocyte identity | Direct promoter synergy and widespread enhancer co-occupancy |
| 13 | **PAX7 · MYF5 · MYOD1 · MYOG** | Skeletal-muscle lineage | Sequential pioneer-to-differentiation relay |
| 14 | **GATA2 · TFAP2C · TEAD4 · MAFK** | Human trophoblast stem cells | Documented preferential co-occupancy at trophoblast enhancers |
| 15 | **RELA · NFKB2 · JUNB · FOS** | Acute inflammatory response | NF-κB and AP-1 dimers cooperating at inflammatory enhancers |
| 16 | **CDX2 · HNF4A · GATA6 · TCF7L2** | Intestinal epithelium | CDX2-dependent accessibility with differentiation- and Wnt-responsive partners |
| 17 | **TP63 · KLF4 · GRHL3 · TFAP2A** | Epidermal/keratinocyte identity | Cooperative establishment and activation of epithelial enhancers |
| 18 | **SMAD3 · SMAD4 · FOXH1 · TCF3** | Nodal/TGF-β mesendoderm response | FOXH1 priming followed by SMAD-complex and E-protein recruitment |
| 19 | **PPARG · RXRA · CEBPA · CEBPB** | Adipocyte differentiation | CEBPB-led enhancer priming followed by PPARG–RXRA occupancy |
